python3 - <<'PY'
from vlb_traj import Session
import numpy as np
s=Session()
s.record_start()
st=s.state(); p=np.array(st['entities']['button2']['position'],float)
q=np.array(st['robot']['tcp_quaternion_wxyz'],float)
target=p.copy(); target[2]-=0.025
ik=s.ik(target,q)
print('target',target,'IK',ik,flush=True)
if ik['success']:
    cmd=np.r_[ik['joint_positions'],[0.04,0.04]]
    for i in range(20):
        status=s.step(cmd)
        if i in (0,2,5,10,19) or status['success']:
            r=s.state()['robot']; print('step',i+1,'tcp',r['tcp_position'],'grip',r['gripper_positions'],'status',status['success'],flush=True)
        if status['success']: break
status=s.status(); print('FINAL',status,flush=True)
a=s.record_stop(); print('actions',a.shape,flush=True)
if status['success']:
    s.save_trajectory(a,'/app/output/trajectory.npz'); print('SAVED',flush=True)
PY
